facts.text: A row of giant white letters stood on the floor, each dotted with small lights.
The small lights on the letters glowed blue.
The letters stood in a long row on a raised platform edged with wide steps.
The banner also mentioned San Francisco.
Thin wires ran between the lights on the letters.
Beanbag chairs were on the floor of the hall.
The hall was huge, with steel beams and long rows of ceiling lights.
Tall banner stands stood near folding tables and chairs.

sessions.note: They didn't say anything during this session.
